people.name: Achish
people.line: Philistine king of Gath, gave refuge to David

people.name: Ziklag
people.line: A city given to David; originally Judah's, then Simeon's

translations.web: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: therefore Ziklag belongs to the kings of Judah to this day.
translations.bsb: That day Achish gave him Ziklag, and to this day it still belongs to the kings of Judah.
translations.kjv: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
translations.asv: Then Achish gave him Ziklag that day: wherefore Ziklag pertaineth unto the kings of Judah unto this day.
